[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-4q[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Inbox routing for Ctrl+Shift+P and Ctrl+Shift+Enter[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]On an open task that lives in an inbox note, every Ctrl+Shift+P [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Task Card commit and every Ctrl+Shift+Enter toggle first asks where[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the task goes. Nothing is written until a destination is chosen. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]The task then lands in its new home with the action applied, and a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]review-walk landing advances to the next item, so morning triage [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]never needs a separate Ctrl+Shift+M.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Inbox routing core in bob-navigation-hotkeys[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]route-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]route-core: add the inbox-note classifier, the route picker modal, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]preflight, the routed move commit (no focus, no park), the walk's new [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`route` outcome kind, and the nav api `inboxRoute` v1 namespace, with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unit and runtime tests; nav 2.9.0.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Route gate on Ctrl+Shift+P Task Card commits[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]task-card-gate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after route-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]task-card-gate: route every non-closing single and counted Task Card [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commit on an inbox task through one picker gate (prompt, write, move, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]settle the walk once), show the Inbox header chip, and add the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]action-by-action conformance matrix; nav 2.10.0.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Route gate on Ctrl+Shift+Enter in block-id-prompt[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]link-toggle-gate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after route-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
